newsitem.title: USA: Agree Realty files $125 mln stock shelf.
newsitem.headline: Agree Realty files $125 mln stock shelf.

text.p: Agree Realty Corp filed Thursday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $125 million in common and preferred stock.
Net proceeds will be used discharge all or a portion of an outstanding principal amount under the $50 million line of credit agreement. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.

Agree, based in Farmington, Hills, Mich., is a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust which owns and manages, retail income-producing properties primarily leased on long-term basis to major retail companies.
